The MyRide Broward app was developed by BusPas Inc. and Broward County Transit Agency.

The MyRide Broward app is a real time information product for Broward County Transit customers, providing bus arrival information, bus location and route schedule information for all Broward County Transit bus routes.

The MyRide Broward app provides:
- Real time bus arrival predictions for Broward County Transit bus stops
- Real time bus locator for in-service Broward County Transit buses
- Find bus stop locations near you
- Route display with stops and buses on the map
- Search capability for bus stops and routes
- List of all scheduled routes and times
- Automatically updated predictions and bus locations
- Favorite Stops list with quick access to your favorite stops
- Feedback template to send comments
- Access to Trip Planning via Google Trip Planner site

This app relies on data obtained from Broward County Transit’s automated vehicle locator services.
Please plan to be at the bus stop a few minutes early, schedule time and arrival time provided by the MyRide Broward app are estimates
